title: Refill the empty roadmap with measured opportunities
body:
Outcome: docs/program/roadmap.md holds at least three ranked rows, each with measured evidence (command, path, numbers) and an open task, covering token cost per slice first (memory:sector-plan-request), then delivery time, CI wall time and review.
Why: after t-kfydr8a closed (#466, #467) the tracker has zero open tasks and the roadmap table is empty; the operator wants the lead to surface improvements unprompted (memory:proactive-opportunity-scan) inside KRN only (memory:krn-only-scope).
Proof: npm run fast PASS with test/rules/roadmap-open-tasks.test.ts green and each row's evidence path present under .krn/runs/.
Scope: this repository; measurement and task creation only; implementation lands in the tasks it creates.
